    JOIN courses AS course

          SELECT 1
          FROM offering_professors AS candidate_professor
          JOIN offering_professors AS target_professor
              ON target_professor.professor_id = candidate_professor.professor_id
          JOIN course_offerings AS target

            AND target.year = 2026
            AND target.semester = '1'
